staffManagement.directory: Existing staff register their name for owner review; registration grants no authority and does not create authentication or membership.
staffManagement.assignment: Owner selects one role and explicit occurrence assignments for Instructor.
safeguards: Current assignment resolved per read and locked command before replay
Atomic role, audit, journal and encrypted recovery receipt

deniedActions: Unavailable navigation and controls hidden; server returns an understandable 403 independently of UI. Sensitive read projections, workflow entry points, command replies and stale replay are guarded.
refundPermission: refunds.manage is an explicit business permission. Only Owner/Admin receives it in the approved V1 mapping; enforcement does not compare a role name to owner.
finance: Owner/Admin and Manager see financial history. Front Desk sees only its own front-desk purchase/payment receipts. Instructor sees no commerce or customer contact information. Unscoped provider inbox is not exposed as business history.
crossBusiness: Explicit business selection is matched against the signed-in account memberships on every request. Independent role assignments, Instructor classes, stale responses and command journals remain scoped. Second tenant/business fixture proves different roles for the same account.
ecosystem: Generic role resolution and assignment contracts are separate from the exact approved Development initial-owner binding. Existing authentication, restricted database role, membership RLS, transactions and recovery remain in use. No schema migration, provider permission changes or new identity system.
